_note: Combinable disruption scenarios. A trigger code joins parts with '+', e.g. STORM+GATE_A+TRAIN_SAND_25+SHUTTLE_FULL. NORMAL = Plan A.

types.label: Storm cell
effects: Everyone should be under cover or on transport before 23:00
Only covered routes and covered gate connections should be used
The shuttle stop has a covered shelter, but in a storm reach it only via the covered Gate D ramp walkway (the Gate A path is uncovered)

types.label: Gate closed
effects: The named gate cannot be used
Places only reachable via that gate close (e.g. Gate A closed closes pickup_zone_1)

types.label: Train line delayed
effects: Every departure on that line leaves {mins} minutes later than timetabled

types.label: Accessible shuttle full
effects: shuttle_acc_2245 has no seats left; existing bookings on it cannot be honoured

types.label: Extreme heat
effects: Plans should name a water point
People with medical or heat-sensitive conditions should be flagged needs_human

types.label: Set running late
effects: That stage's remaining sets finish {mins} minutes later; leaving times shift accordingly
